tickets.check: tools/play.sh 120 "START HELP_OPEN HELP_CLOSE MENU_OPEN MENU_CLOSE TIP END FINISH" --autopilot --skip-intro && tools/test.sh tests/test_hud.gd

tickets.check: test -f assets/generated/whale.glb && test -f assets/generated/petunias.glb && echo CHECK OK

tickets.title: Win and lose screens

tickets.check: test -f audio/music_loop.wav && tools/play.sh 150 "MUSIC_START SFX END FINISH" --autopilot --skip-intro

tickets.title: Camp, crew and beach dressing
tickets.check: tools/play.sh 150 "CAMP END FINISH" --autopilot --skip-intro && tools/play.sh 90 "CAMP CREW END FINISH" --autopilot --skip-intro --force-lose

tickets.check: tools/test.sh tests/test_hud.gd && tools/probe.sh tests/play_treasure.tscn 90 "TREASURE OK" --skip-intro && tools/play.sh 150 "TREASURE START END FINISH" --autopilot --skip-intro
